steps: Administrator assigns a principal to a governed role.
Role expands to a stable set of allowed actions.
Request arrives for a specific protected resource.
Enforcer permits only when an active role grants that action.

lesson.scenario: A production console grants operators role-defined actions while preventing a viewer from restarting a database.

steps.title: Load role assignments
steps.narration: Alice has prod-db-operator; Bob has prod-observer. The operator role includes db.restart, while observer includes db.read.

alice.detail: No work accepted in this phase

bob.detail: No work accepted in this phase

db.detail: No work accepted in this phase

steps.outcome: Permissions are inherited through named roles.
steps.invariant: Permissions come from reviewed role definitions, and every operation is denied unless the principal has an explicit role-to-action grant.

steps.title: Evaluate Alice action
steps.narration: The evaluator matches Alice role prod-db-operator to db.restart and requires an incident ticket claim.

bob.detail: No work accepted in this phase

db.detail: No work accepted in this phase

steps.outcome: Alice passes role and context prerequisites.
steps.invariant: Permissions come from reviewed role definitions, and every operation is denied unless the principal has an explicit role-to-action grant.

steps.title: Restart the database
steps.narration: The console restarts the read replica first and records actor, role, ticket, resource, and policy revision.

bob.detail: No work accepted in this phase

steps.invariant: Permissions come from reviewed role definitions, and every operation is denied unless the principal has an explicit role-to-action grant.

steps.title: Deny Bob action
steps.narration: Bob is authenticated, but prod-observer has no db.restart permission.
steps.outcome: The action is denied before reaching the database.
steps.invariant: Permissions come from reviewed role definitions, and every operation is denied unless the principal has an explicit role-to-action grant.

steps.title: Allow Bob read access
steps.narration: The same role permits Bob to view replication lag and connection count.
